title: Loud booms heard near Saudi Aramco headquarters in Dhahran, sources say

content:
Oct 13 (Reuters) – Loud booms were heard in the vicinity of Saudi Aramco’s headquarters in ​Dhahran on Tuesday night, ‌six sources told Reuters.

There was no official comment or confirmation from Aramco.

One source said the Aramco headquarters was ‌on ​fire. An evacuation ⁠order for the ⁠building had been issued, four of the sources said.

A source with direct knowledge of the matter ​told Reuters the Aramco headquarters had been struck, adding ⁠that it was unclear ⁠if the building had ​been hit directly or by falling ​debris.

The Saudi-led coalition said fragments ‌of a missile that it had intercepted and destroyed in Dhahran had fallen on a ⁠residential area without providing further details.

Aramco employees were instructed to work from home ⁠on Wednesday, ‌a direct source ⁠told Reuters.

The Saudi civil defense ​later ‌issued an alert of ​potential danger ⁠in the capital Riyadh and a loud boom was heard in that city afterwards.

(Reporting by Reuters; Editing by Mark Porter and ​Cynthia Osterman)
